Sessions / Session 02

Session 02 — Conflict is a Surety

Player-facing recap: Session 02 Recap

Durable Changes

  • Barnaby Rook — presumed dead; taken by something in the water after going in a second time.
  • Party now commands the HCS Surety. The Saltwright departed with Beaumont Sel.
  • Crew assembled: Geoffrey Draves, Sem Holst (shipwright), Alys Kuiper (surgeon), Old Faas (rigger), Thunk, Noor. Shepherd Grigori aboard until Calveno.
  • Ket (Moucheron) freed from cage; flew toward Murrat.
  • Ensign Wouters killed (shot by Delmar through a gun port).
  • Perrin received Mira’s Blade from the cargo.
  • Jean-Claude confirmed three truths via Truth Stone: former kinsmen hunted him, he stowed away, nobody sent him.
  • Perrin named himself as a Black-Jaw to the assembled crew.
  • Party levelled up at session end.
  • Cargo recovered: 45 gp + letters of marque + blunderbuss (cabin); 110 gp + 2 garnets (under floor); pendant + flintlocks + Mira’s Blade + 20 vials Grung tincture (cargo crate).

Scene Log

  • Gangplank continuation: Crissdalynn deflected Rook’s flintlock on her bracers; her wind bent him toward the rail. Beaumont threw Bisou through a gun port — she pissed in the powder, cannons neutralized. Delmar fired through the second port, hit Wouters below. Rook went back up the rigging. Delmar threw a chair (wind-assisted). Rook went into the water; something eel-like was in it; he didn’t come back. Crissdalynn retrieved his admiral hat with a boat hook. Beaumont: “Belongs to the captain.”
  • Settlement of accounts: Beaumont to Perrin — Friend of the Passage; Nona Black-Jaw message delivered. Beaumont to Jean-Claude — Truth Stone; Jean-Claude confirmed his three truths.
  • The galley: Geoffrey led them below. Shepherd Grigori at the head of the table — assessed the party before cooperating. Named Cap’n Gorgeous and Rupert Knighton. His condition: anyone off at the next port walks free. Then: “You forgot to feed Ket.”
  • Ket: Party found the caged Moucheron. Jean-Claude fed him blood from a wine glass (abdomen went red, calmer). Crissdalynn stepped past safe distance — Ket fed from her arm. Perrin moved to kill; Crissdalynn blocked; Perrin cast Tasha’s Hideous Laughter (mosquito honks). Freed with Wouters’ body as lure. Flew toward Murrat.
  • Crew assembly: Listed above. Grigori is leaving at Calveno for Il Gioco delle Beffe. Perrin named himself to the crew.
  • Cargo: Contents recovered. Mira’s Blade to Perrin.
  • Dawn departure: Beaumont warned weather toward Calveno; said he can be found in Kalowe when off route. Delmar mentioned Admiral Fisk. Bisou took 15 gp of shinies; Beaumont called it fair business. Saltwright pulled away.
  • Storm: Tropical storm hit two hours out. Jean-Claude seasick. Aldenmere (Crown Isle) glimpsed northwest in a gap — closed. Three hull impacts, third deliberate — Surety lurched to port. Jean-Claude reached for his spyglass.

Entity Updates

  • Barnaby Rook — presumed dead
  • Beaumont Sel — departed on Saltwright; friend of the party
  • HCS Surety — party vessel; Crown-marked; hull taking impacts
  • Saltwright — departed with Beaumont
  • Jean-Claude Tabarnack — Truth Stone truths confirmed; 20 vials in cargo; says nothing
  • Perrin Black-Jaw — named himself; received Mira’s Blade; Passage status granted
  • Delmar Fisk — revealed Admiral Fisk connection
  • Crissdalynn Khinriss — deflected flintlock; let Ket feed from her

Situation And Faction Updates

  • Situation created: Hull Impacts — something large is hitting the hull
  • Situation created: The Knighton Pursuit — Rupert Knighton will send ships
  • Situation created: Nona and Anzolo — Perrin named; Nona’s search is live
  • Situation updated: The Canister — 20 vials now in party possession; evidence escalated
  • Situation resolved: The Rook Resolution — Rook is dead (presumed)

Open Questions

  • What is hitting the hull? Is it the eel-creature that took Rook?
  • What is aboard the Aldenmere Crown Isle? Could the creature be based there?
  • Does Jean-Claude ever tell the party about the 20 vials?
  • Who is Admiral Fisk? What is Delmar’s relationship to him?
  • Will Grigori be more useful before he leaves at Calveno?
  • When does Anzolo find Perrin?

Follow-Up Queue

  • Expand Shepherd Grigori before Calveno arrival — what does he know about Rook’s operations?
  • Decide the hull creature — needs a creature page when identified
  • Expand crew stubs (Sem, Alys, Faas, Thunk, Noor) as they become distinct
  • Rename the HCS Surety — party has not yet chosen a name
  • Update party-session-primer with ship, crew, and level
complete

Rook dies in the water. Party takes the HCS Surety, assembles a crew, and frees Ket the Moucheron. Three new active situations: hull impacts, Knighton pursuit, and Nona/Anzolo. Party levelled up.
